mathematical_sources.note: Lecture notes. Theorem1.17, printedp6, and supporting Lemmas1.5–1.6. The direct proof constructs an open continuous surjection. The formal statement explicitly adds the necessary nonempty hypothesis omitted from the informal theorem statement. Source PDF text consulted independently; no complete downloaded PDF digest is claimed.
mathematical_sources.title: Descriptive Set Theory, Fall 2002 lecture notes

mathematical_sources.note: Section10, printedp16, recalls classical Polish open representation and attributes it to Kechris Exercise7.14 before its quasi-Polish generalization. We do not formalize the quasi-Polish theorem. The original Kechris book pages were not independently consulted.
mathematical_sources.title: Notes on quasi-Polish spaces, arXiv1809.07440v2

related_formalizations.note: Felix Weilacher’s generic limit, total-domain and continuity theorems are reused with attribution. New work constructs the open covering scheme and proves exact cylinder images, then openness/surjectivity.

Existing continuous-only Baire representation does not assert openness. Local exact-pin semantic audit found no equivalent open representation. This is not exhaustive global/private duplicate clearance.
